dedupe_keys.name: gie agsi and alsi daily gas storage and lng terminal inventory transparency platforms

description: AGSI+ and ALSI+ are the transparency platforms of Gas Infrastructure Europe for underground gas storage and large-scale LNG terminals. They give inventory reporting at daily resolution: storage filling levels, injection and withdrawal for storage sites, and stock and send-out for LNG terminals. The platforms are a voluntary initiative of storage and LNG operators, and GIE describes them as a benchmark to monitor pan-European storage filling and LNG send-out. According to GIE, 100 percent of the underground gas storage market in the EU27 is covered on AGSI and all EU27 large-scale LNG terminals are listed on ALSI. GIE also runs an Inside Information Platform for urgent market messages from operators. Coverage is the EU27 and other reporting European operators, by site, company and country. Data can be browsed on the websites; the API requires an API key (it returned an invalid or missing key error without one). No licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: figures are reported by operators themselves, and the web pages render in the browser, so details beyond the overview were not read. Simulation uses are gas security of supply studies, winter stress tests of storage drawdown and LNG import scenarios. Related records: data-entsog-transparency-platform covers pipeline flows at interconnection points.
